result.title: SafeOrchestrate: Runtime Checked Intent-Driven Orchestration for Cyber-Physical Systems
result.summary: Modern cyber physical systems (CPS) integrate heterogeneous sensors, actuators, controllers, and services, composed at runtime rather than at design time. Orchestrating such systems through natural language (NL) is attractive, but unconstrained large language model (LLM) tool use is risky because actions must respect device capabilities, runtime state, and safety constraints. We present Safe Orchestrate, a reference architecture for runtime checked, intent driven CPS orchestration. Given an NL intent, it derives atomic goals, generates a runtime checkable specification for each, grounds the specifications to device affordances, and verifies every candidate action against runtime state and safety constraints before execution. In a Web of Things (WoT) instantiation, the architecture produces Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) style specifications from the NL intent, grounds them to Thing Description (TD) affordances exposed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and checks candidate actions against satisfiability modulo theories (SMT) backed guardrails. We evaluate this instantiation on simulated smart home, greenhouse, and industrial automation tasks against a direct LLM to MCP baseline. Safe Orchestrate maintains 100% required action accuracy on every task and 100% MCP Execution Similarity (MCP ES) on all but one, where MCP ES is 92%. By contrast, the baseline degrades on multi device, event triggered, and ordered tasks, with MCP ES falling to 13%. These results suggest that combining LLM based specification generation with role aware grounding and runtime constraint checking improves reliability for open CPS orchestration without enriched TD annotations or planning domain expertise.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SafeOrchestrate 参考架构：从自然语言意图抽取原子目标并生成运行时可检查的 LTL 风格规范，经 MCP 把规范落到设备能力（Thing Description），再用 SMT 后端护栏在执行前逐个校验候选动作；在仿真智能家居、温室和工业任务上与直接调用 MCP 的 LLM 基线对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先形式化规范、再对每个候选动作做运行时约束校验」的流程，可能为 LVR 中候选推理状态或停止决策的外部校验提供概念参照，但该工作不涉及视觉输入、latent 状态或答案生成，迁移价值需自行核查。
